Name: Simple Bundle Indicator
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎁 Simple Bundle Indicator[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#A7F3D0]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]See which items are still needed for unfinished Community Center bundles. Red borders highlight matching items in your Inventory tab and chest grids, with an optional small bundle icon.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Choose Your Indicators[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Red slot borders[/b] — On by default. Drawn behind the item, quality star and stack number.
[b]Top-left bundle icon[/b] — Off by default. Enable it separately or use it together with borders.
[b]Horizontal / vertical icon offsets[/b] — Move the icon from −64 to +64 UI pixels on each axis. Zero keeps the original position.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to adjust the controls. Enable the bundle icon to see position changes. Save keeps your choices; Default restores the original settings.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52769/52769-1792352415-1738715974.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52769/52769-1792352415-848163633.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Previews show controlled native game and GMCM renders.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]🌱 What Gets Marked[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Items are checked against current bundle requirements, donation progress and minimum quality. Smaller stacks are marked too: one Gold Parsnip is still useful toward a requirement of five. Normal and remixed Community Center bundles are supported.

Indicators disappear when the requirement is completed. Marked items remain usable normally. Vault money requirements and the abandoned JojaMart’s Missing Bundle are excluded; markers stop on the Joja route or after completing the Community Center.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English · Korean · Simplified Chinese · Spanish · Brazilian Portuguese · Russian · Turkish · German · French · Japanese · Italian · Hungarian[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]📦 Install & Configure[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.4.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6.15+. Extract [b]SimpleBundleIndicator[/b] into your Mods folder. If an older installation uses a [b]CCBundleIndicator[/b] folder, remove that older folder to avoid duplicate copies.

Without GMCM, close the game and edit [b]ShowRedBorders[/b], [b]ShowTopLeftIcon[/b], [b]IconOffsetX[/b] and [b]IconOffsetY[/b] in the generated config.json. To remove the mod, delete its folder.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Works with supported scrolling inventory grids. Shops, crafting screens, bundle screens, toolbars and held-item drawings receive no markers. Custom menus that replace the normal inventory drawing may need their own integration.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Have a bug or an idea? Post it on this page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. A screenshot or short video helps with positioning issues. For suggestions, explain what you would like changed and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
